description: Comprehensive theme updates including UI improvements, footer implementation, font consistency, and feature additions for the Lloyd Steven Shopify store.

stories.title: Replace MENU text with hamburger icon
stories.description: Replace the text 'MENU' with a 2-line hamburger icon in the header navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Hamburger icon displays with 2 horizontal lines
Icon appears consistently on desktop and mobile
Icon maintains proper spacing and alignment with header
Icon is clickable and opens menu as expected

stories.title: Update page navigation names for consistency
stories.description: Update page names in navigation to match URL slugs and page titles: 'ABOUT US' → 'ABOUT', 'CUSTOMER INFO GUIDE' → 'CUSTOMER SUPPORT', 'CUSTOMS PROCESS' → 'CUSTOM DESIGN AND CONCIERGE'
acceptance_criteria: Navigation displays 'ABOUT' instead of 'ABOUT US'
Navigation displays 'CUSTOMER SUPPORT' instead of 'CUSTOMER INFO GUIDE'
Navigation displays 'CUSTOM DESIGN AND CONCIERGE' instead of 'CUSTOMS PROCESS'
Names are consistent across all menu locations
stories.notes: This is likely a Shopify admin navigation menu configuration change, not code

stories.title: Remove unused pages
stories.description: Remove pages that are not in use: ABOUT, POLICIES, CUSTOMS GALLERY, SHOGUN LANDING, DEFAULT, etc.
acceptance_criteria: Unused pages are deleted from Shopify admin
No broken links remain on the site
Navigation no longer references deleted pages
stories.notes: This is a Shopify admin task - delete pages via admin panel, not code

stories.title: Build and style footer across all pages
stories.description: Implement footer design based on Figma specs and THE ROW website reference. Homepage should have Lloyd Steven logo centered with footer barely visible without scroll. Other pages should have decent spacing before footer.
acceptance_criteria: Footer appears on all pages
Homepage footer is positioned low with logo appearing centered
Interior pages have appropriate spacing between content and footer
Footer design matches Figma specifications
Footer content matches THE ROW website styling approach
Footer is responsive on mobile and desktop

stories.title: Add anchor links in footer to page sections
stories.description: When footer links to 'Custom Gallery', it should jump to the Custom Gallery section on the customs process page. Privacy Policy and Terms links should jump directly to those sections in customer support page.
acceptance_criteria: Footer 'Custom Gallery' link jumps to Custom Gallery section on customs process page
Privacy Policy link jumps to Privacy Policy section
Terms link jumps to Terms section
Anchor links work smoothly with appropriate scroll behavior
Links work correctly on both desktop and mobile

stories.title: Site-wide font size audit and consistency
stories.description: Review and standardize all font sizes across the site. Heading fonts should read small across all pages (About page is reference). Enable center-alignment for paragraphs and provide consistent header/text size options.
acceptance_criteria: All heading fonts match the scale used on About page
Font sizes are consistent across all page types
Paragraphs can be center-aligned when needed
Header and text size options are clearly defined and consistent
Typography system is documented in CSS/theme settings

stories.title: Format Customs Process intro paragraph
stories.description: The 'Customs and Concierge' intro paragraph should be center-aligned and font/size should match the paragraphs below it.
acceptance_criteria: Intro paragraph is center-aligned
Font and size match other paragraphs on the page
Formatting is consistent on desktop and mobile

stories.title: Fix Customer Guide mobile dropdown consistency
stories.description: On mobile, dropdown menu sections appear inconsistent (some thicker, some thinner). Make all sections consistent while maintaining desktop appearance.
acceptance_criteria: All dropdown sections have consistent thickness on mobile
Desktop view remains unchanged
Visual consistency across all accordion/dropdown elements

stories.title: Fix About Us page formatting issues
stories.description: Desktop: Second paragraph text box is too low - should align with other photos. Mobile: Reduce gaps between image/text blocks, especially after second block.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop: Second paragraph text box aligns properly with photos
Mobile: Gaps between image/text blocks are reduced appropriately
Mobile: Gap after second block is noticeably smaller
Layout remains responsive and clean

stories.title: Format collection descriptions above product grid
stories.description: Custom descriptions exist in each collection but are hidden. Format them so collection name is small (consistent with header text size) and paragraph below is center-aligned.
acceptance_criteria: Collection name displays in small header size (consistent with site headers)
Description paragraph is center-aligned
Formatting appears above product grid
Styling is consistent across all collection pages
Responsive on mobile and desktop

stories.title: Reduce product title size on product pages
stories.description: Product titles are too large, especially on mobile. Should match 'small' heading size (reference: About page heading scale).
acceptance_criteria: Product title size matches small heading standard
Size is consistent with About page heading scale
Particularly improved on mobile view
Applied to all product templates

stories.title: Fix menu scroll issue on desktop and mobile
stories.description: Menu cannot scroll down on desktop or mobile - it stops at 'ABOUT' preventing access to items below.
acceptance_criteria: Menu scrolls properly on desktop
Menu scrolls properly on mobile
All menu items are accessible
Scroll behavior is smooth and intuitive
No items are cut off or hidden

stories.title: Add editorial images/video to collection pages
stories.description: Enable editorial images (and video if possible) on collection pages. A 'Collection Editorial Image' metafield has been created but needs to be implemented in the theme.
acceptance_criteria: Collection Editorial Image metafield displays on collection pages
Editorial images render properly within collection layout
Video support is implemented if theme-compatible
Editorial content maintains collection theme consistency
Feature works across all collection pages
Responsive on mobile and desktop
stories.notes: Investigate theme capabilities for media rendering

stories.title: Implement fast-loading product video across all products
stories.description: Replicate the clean, fast video loading experience from reference product page across all product pages to enable video addition for all styles.
acceptance_criteria: Video loads quickly and smoothly on product pages
Video player experience matches reference product
All product templates support video
Video maintains quality while loading efficiently
Mobile and desktop video experience is optimized
No impact on page load performance
stories.notes: May require Shopify video media type implementation

stories.title: Update Google metadata and search preview
stories.description: Update site metadata for Google search preview to display: 'LLOYD STEVEN | FINE JEWELLERY MADE IN AUSTRALIA' with description about precious metals, ethically sourced stones, and concierge services.
acceptance_criteria: Meta title reads 'LLOYD STEVEN | FINE JEWELLERY MADE IN AUSTRALIA'
Meta description includes: precious metals, ethically sourced stones, concierge services, custom design, private styling
Search preview displays correctly in Google
Metadata is set in Shopify admin SEO settings
stories.notes: This is primarily a Shopify admin Online Store > Preferences change, though theme.liquid may need meta tag verification

technical_notes.theme_structure: Standard Shopify theme with sections, snippets, templates, assets
technical_notes.content_vs_code: Stories marked 'content' type are primarily Shopify admin changes. Stories marked 'code' type require template/CSS/JS modifications.

success_criteria.all_stories_complete: All stories marked with passes: true
success_criteria.responsive_design: All changes work on mobile and desktop
success_criteria.performance: No degradation in page load times
success_criteria.consistency: Typography and spacing consistent across all pages
